notes: First stable major. URL parameter serialization changed (params are now percent-encoded by default), the request-interceptor config type changed, and the ESM/default export was reworked. Existing code that relied on the old param serialization or on named type imports needs migration.

evidence.text: v1.x introduced several breaking changes to how URL parameters are serialized. The most important one is that params are now percent-encoded by default, which changes the on-the-wire representation of requests compared to 0.x. The import surface changed so that consumers use the default export. When typing the config parameter in a request interceptor you now need to use the InternalAxiosRequestConfig type instead of AxiosRequestConfig. There are multiple deprecations, refactors, and removals in this release; read through the full release notes to see how this may impact your project and use case.
